requirement: Deleting a WordPress or Joomla record that lives in several languages is one door question and one call: content.delete with no locale names the record's N languages in its question, the yes authorises exactly that group, and one call deletes each member through the plugin's per-item delete under one apply_id; locale keeps a delete to one language

oracle.ref: PR #1026 (fix); fix evidence: Local stand 09/10/2026, benchwp02 (news post in 41 languages), request 'Xoá bài tin "Four common mistakes in heavy machine foundation design" khỏi website': one run made 82 refused content.delete calls (CONFIRM_FIRST), 4 questions to the customer, 109 tool calls, 1.3M prompt tokens, 274 s, and left 39 translations live (~/tracy-bench-work/bench/out-v7-abl-hb-after3-noorder-r1-r1/benchwp02/V7-delete-chat-dev); other runs deleted with wp post delete in bash. benchjoomla02 showed the same loop at 12-17 calls.
oracle.invariant: S2: every test named in run.tests reports ok. On a fake WordPress site (a post in 3 languages, Polylang group read from content.read) and a fake Joomla site (an article in 2 languages, associations): content.delete {kind, id} with no locale is refused CONFIRM_FIRST with languages:N and a question naming the title 'in all N languages', nothing deleted; after the customer's yes to that question one call sends one content.delete per member (the named one first) under one apply_id and answers deleted [{id, locale}] plus one undo; a member that fails is listed in failed with its code while the others go; the named record refused stops the rest; a lost answer stops the walk and lists the rest NOT_SENT; locale keeps the delete to one record and its answer names what stays online; a locale that is not the record's is refused LOCALE_NOT_THIS_RECORD with the right call; the yes never opens another record or a second call; a one-language site, a record not listed, or an unreadable listing leaves the plain one-record question. Every command exits 0.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
